title: klayout-tools remote-sim AMI manifest
description: The published-AMI registry the `remote` `klt sim` backend's launcher (src/klayout_tools/remote_launcher.py) resolves against, per docs/design/remote-sim-backend-spike.md decision 4 (bake ngspice + curated PDK decks into a maintained, versioned AMI -- never fetched per job). Produced/refreshed by scripts/aws/build-remote-sim-ami.sh, one entry per (pdk, region) build. `resolve_ami()` picks the most recently built entry for a given (pdk, region) pair; it never guesses across regions or falls back to a stale entry silently.

schema_version.description: Manifest format version, independent of any `klt` command's own JSON `schema_version` (see docs/json-contract.md) -- this file is build-pipeline output, not a `klt` command response.

images.description: One entry per published AMI build. Multiple entries may share a (pdk, region) pair across builds -- resolve_ami() always selects the entry with the latest `built_at` for a given pair, so older entries are kept only as an audit trail, not pruned by this schema.

pdk.description: PDK combination this AMI's baked model decks cover. Must match src/klayout_tools/remote_launcher.py's SUPPORTED_PDKS.

region.description: AWS region this AMI is published/copied into (an AMI id is region-scoped; a multi-region rollout needs one entry per region, per scripts/aws/build-remote-sim-ami.sh's --copy-to-region).

ami_id.description: The published AMI id, e.g. ami-0123456789abcdef0.

pdk_snapshot.description: The PDK's own release identifier baked into this AMI (e.g. 'sky130A-2026.06.01') -- decision 5's reproducibility provenance, echoed into a `remote` run's response `environment.remote.pdk_snapshot`.

ngspice_version.description: ngspice version baked into this AMI (e.g. '46') -- pinned to the same major version this repo tests against, per the design note's decision 5.

built_at.description: ISO-8601 build timestamp (UTC). resolve_ami() compares this string directly (ISO-8601 sorts chronologically as a plain string) to pick the most recent entry for a (pdk, region) pair.

klt_version.description: The `klt --version` build string (without the leading `klt `) that this image's baked klayout-tools reports, e.g. '0.7.0' or '0.7.1.dev3+gabc1234' (issue #2851). Published by scripts/aws/build-remote-sim-ami.sh from the version the pinned `klt_ref` installed. The `batch` backend compares it with the submitting client before any submit/launch (release-segment major.minor rule, issue #3184). Publication metadata, not proof of the bytes a job executes; the runner-side preflight still runs. Optional: absent on historical entries, which means unknown.

klt_ref.description: The git ref (the build script's `--klt-ref`, by default the commit it ran from) klayout-tools was pip-installed from on this image (issue #2851). Audit provenance only; never compared. Optional: absent on historical entries.

pdk_variants.description: The PDK variant directory names this image ships (e.g. ['gf180mcuD']) (issue #3251). The `batch` backend refuses a request whose `models.pdk` variant is not listed, before any S3 write, when every candidate image publishes this field. Optional: absent on historical entries, which means unknown.

notes.description: Free-form build notes (e.g. base AMI id, packer/build-tool version). Optional.
